purpose: Verify source-package retention creation, same-turn correction, qualified fresh-session application and no-write boundaries.
core_change: Explicit initial-account and cross-source retention responsibilities plus same-turn reconciliation of claims, examples, implications and next actions. Existing skill methods and host rules unchanged.

semantic_review.method: Parent inspected both initial stale accounts, all four final revised accounts, revised Luma recommendations, and changed-case answers across conditions against the supplied sources. No independent or blinded grading claimed.
semantic_review.initial_candidate: Failed maintenance: both accounts remained stale after correction and exception evidence despite correct subsequent answers.
semantic_review.harbor_regression: Both revised-core accounts integrated the correction, historical status, scoped multiplier, item/current-v2 exceptions, unknown depot mapping and dependent examples/actions. Fresh sessions read them and answered the central changed-case questions correctly.
semantic_review.sable_independent_transfer: Both accounts integrated the 14-day ordinary, 60-day event, held-snapshot and unknown-collection distinctions, plus complete-inventory and actual-consumer restoration requirements. Fresh applications consulted these accounts and preserved the relevant limits. Both Luma no-write preference changes were applied to the answer, not saved, and explicitly disclosed as unsaved.
semantic_review.baseline: Stock and source-only also answered central changed-case questions correctly from original evidence. Neither authored an account. No answer-quality advantage established.

retained_record_link_checks.limit: Valid links do not prove semantic fidelity; initial stale accounts also passed.

recovered_tool_errors.kind: Reads of absent .git in non-repository fixtures. No write failures.

interpretation: The implemented revision demonstrated creation, same-turn correction and fresh-session consultation on a post-failure regression and a different synthetic scenario. This is bounded behavioral evidence, not broad reliability or an advantage attributable to memory.
limits: Harbor was reused after its maintenance failure; the revised result is a regression, not held-out validation.
Sable was introduced after the correction paragraph was frozen, but remains a small synthetic scenario on one configured host/model.
Full original evidence and incoming requests were available to all arms, and Luma reread sources; record consultation alone does not isolate its answer-quality contribution.
No actual compaction, long-duration project, concurrent human edits or other-host validation.
Published source changes are not installed or activated in existing user workspaces.
